Companion Animal Check-In and Pet Relief Reminders

Travelers, please review this notice to ensure your pet’s movement through Aurelia Skyways is smooth, safe, and well coordinated.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk welcomes questions in a warm professional tone and can guide you from booking through pickup. Our ground team handles carriers carefully between services, and we share practical instructions with crews so that your Milolet (or your own pet) is treated consistently at each step. If anything changes in your travel plans, contact us as early as possible so the coordination team can update your handling notes.

Operational guidance is especially important for arrival routines and relief areas. The skyport also limits daily handling, so planning ahead helps us maintain a calm environment for all companions.

If you are traveling with Sara Fischer or Emil Cohen, or if you are a traveler acting on your own behalf, the desk can confirm what to expect during transfer and pickup. We prioritize clear, plain instructions and will help you understand how to keep your pet comfortable during carrier transitions and waiting periods.

For the most reliable support, please reach the Companion Animal Travel Desk as you prepare for check-in and again any time your itinerary or pet needs change. Companion Animal Travel Desk
